title: agenda (widget tool input)
description: What the agent sends to the widget tool: the payload without id, rev and producer (the tool sets them); fallback_text optional (the tool writes it); from_file allowed. A schedule: one day as blocks with free time and the now line, or the days ahead as one line each.

view.description: day: one day as blocks. days: one line per day (the week ahead).

date.description: The day (view day) or the first day (view days).

span.description: Days in view days, from `date`: 5 for a working week, 7 for the week ahead. Only with view days.

start.description: A date-time; a date for all-day events.

end.description: A date-time; for all-day events the last day (inclusive). Leave it out when unknown: the client shows only the start and never invents a length.

all_day.description: An all-day item: a birthday, a holiday, a trip day. Shown above the timed events with an “All day” chip.

name.description: Where, in a few words: “EWR Terminal C”, “200 W 57th St”, “Zoom”.

address.description: The street address when it isn’t the name.

url.description: A call link (Zoom, Meet, FaceTime web) or the place’s page. Join / Open shows the domain first.

place.description: A place. With lat and lon the row’s menu offers Directions (opens Maps on this device); with url, Join or Open.

people.description: Who else is there: “With Ada and Ops”. The person themself is left out.

note.description: The rest of the second line: “leave by 10:40”, “bring the lease”.

state.description: confirmed: a solid ink bar. tentative: a hollow bar and “Maybe”. invited: a hollow bar and “Not answered”. cancelled: grey, struck through, “Cancelled”.

tags.description: Flags on the block’s trailing edge: “Leave by 10:40” (warning), “Moved” (info).

actions.description: Up to two buttons on the row. A reply action sends its id with `{item: <id>}`.

events.description: Every event in the range, in any order; the client sorts them. Send all of them in view days too: the counts are computed from this list.

complete.description: true only when the events come from every calendar the person uses. Only then does the client draw free blocks and say “Free all day”; otherwise a gap is just a gap.

hours.description: The working or waking window. Free blocks are always drawn between events; with hours, also from its start to the first event and from the last event to its end.

day_notes.description: One short line for a day, shown instead of its count in view days and under the header in view day: “Travel day”, “Office closed”.

time_zone.description: IANA zone to show every time in: Europe/London for a trip. Without it each time shows in its own offset, the wall-clock time where it happens (as in `timeline`).
